key_insight: MorphoStain uses physics-guided AI to separate overlapping Tau and amyloid-β stain signals in Alzheimer’s neuropathology, not cancer drug discovery.
clinical_relevance: The approach could support research quantification of Alzheimer’s pathology, but the abstract does not establish clinical diagnostic utility.
method: Unsupervised latent diffusion teacher guided by Beer–Lambert optical-density physics and pathology foundation models.
Morphological routing to disentangle targets sharing the same chromogen.
Distillation into a 0.12-million-parameter U-Net for fast inference.
evidence_signal: On 9,908 held-out SEA-AD patches, the authors report 40.56 dB PSNR, 0.9961 SSIM and 140.1 FPS, with significant gains over InverseAE and NMF (both p < 0.001).
watch_item: Identical-spectrum separation remains mathematically ill-posed; high image-similarity scores alone do not establish biologically accurate target attribution.
paper_title: MorphoStain: Physics-Guided Latent Diffusion and Morphological Distillation for Multiplex Stain Decomposition in Alzheimer's Neuropathology
